purpose: Additive research overlay for the 51 expansion sites. Contains site identity, jurisdiction, location, ownership/operator, mining method/status, and source-backed geological fields only.
nonOverwritePolicy: Does not replace or rewrite resources.json, resources_2.json, the 199-site canonical catalog, or the 51-site expansion catalog.
rules: Never infer a numerical grade, purity, reserve or coordinate from a generic country/commodity average.
Keep unknown fields explicitly UNOBSERVED or UNQUANTIFIED.
Grade is ore/commodity concentration, not refined-product purity.
Reserve and resource classes must retain the source reporting framework and effective date when available.
Map coordinates from this dataset are copied from the expansion catalog and retain their coordinateStatus; they are not survey-grade by default.
Real-world operational status is descriptive metadata only and does not directly set gameplay extraction output.
